issue_context.title: Can't debug C native dependency of WASM Blazor
issue_context.body:
### Is there an existing issue for this? - [X] I have searched the existing issues ### Describe the bug Following this guideline https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/blazor/webassembly-native-dependencies?view=aspnetcore-6.0#use-native-code, we can add a C library easily to a WASM Blazor project. But when we try to debug it using Visual Studio 2022 for Windows, for example setting a breakpoint anywhere in the C code, we get a "The Breakpoint will not currently be hit. Unbound breakpoint" error. ### Expected Behavior We should be able to debug C code added using the aforementioned guideline (using ), including setting breakpoints and being able to analyze C variable contents. ### Steps To Reproduce Copied from https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/blazor/webassembly-native-dependencies?view=aspnetcore-6.0#use-native-code 1.Create a new Blazor WebAssembly project. 2.Add a Test.c file to the project. 3.Add a C function for computing factorials, for example Test.c: ``` int fact(int n) { if (n == 0) return 1; return n * fact(n - 1); } ``` 4.Add a NativeFileReference for Test.c in the app's project file: ``` ``` 5.In a Razor component, add a [DllImportAttribute] for the fact function in the generated Test library and call the fact method from .NET code in the component. ``` @page "/native-c-test" @using System.Runtime.InteropServices Native C

Native C Test

@@fact(3) result: @fact(3)

@code { [DllImport("Test")] static extern int fact(int n); } ``` 6. set breakpoint in C file 7. launch Blazor debugging in a browser ### Exceptions (if any) _No response_ ### .NET Version 6.0 ### Anything else?
